search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail (*Channel OR *Recorder)
| parse "\"eventSource\":\"*\"" as event_source | where event_source="config.amazonaws.com"
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name 
| where event_name in ("DeleteDeliveryChannel","PutDeliveryChannel","PutConfigurationRecorder","StopConfigurationRecorder")
// EoQ
